title: Nitrogen ice bought at Alpha Centauri, made into liquid nitrogen there by hand, sold into Sol Central's deep bid one jump on
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY and P6: the traders left at the capitals take standing work where they stand; rule F8, O1: a cargo run, no empty burn out). 15 Solarian-born traders wait at Nova Terra and Alpha Centauri after the once lines (fill.py status trader 18:25 UTC). Books (table books, 18:43 UTC): Alpha Centauri Colonial Station asks nitrogen ice at 1 cr x 290,725; Confederacy Central Command (Sol) bids liquid nitrogen 4 cr x 8,672, the station's bid, which refilled after 340 units sold (craft-sell-nitrogen-sol-central, 2026-11-23 04:12 UTC); Sol's own ice ask fell to 3 cr x 85, which closed that route. process_nitrogen_ice: 5 ice -> 4 liquid nitrogen. A Theoria (72) takes 70 ice: 14 runs, 56 liquid nitrogen, about +153 cr a load before fuel; Alpha Centauri to Sol is 1 jump (scripts/map.py route). requires.ask and requires.bid close it while either end is gone. A trade of the class (F23) that trains crafting and trading; one route of the plan's order, no hand. Liquid nitrogen above its reserve max: all that is made is sold, nothing stored. 2026-11-23 19:50 UTC (Mercury): 29 runs +1,862 cr together, none lost (runs.jsonl 19:02 to 19:33 UTC). The Nebula-born traders reach Haven after their own once lines and wait there (four at 19:47 UTC; Grand Exchange's cheapest craft costs about 15 cr a run): max_jumps 4 -> 16 and max_ships 15 -> 30, so they come over as a corridor with paid work at its end. Haven to Alpha Centauri 13 jumps, 7 lawless (keelbreak to miaplacidus): 0 pirates in 2 to 130 readings of each (data/intel/sightings.jsonl), no public battle there (table public_battles); the hold is empty on the way. Sol's liquid nitrogen bid 4 cr x 8,672, the station's.
